name: Anchor resolver: ok / moved / changed / broken
description:
Resolution order: hint line + context match -> context elsewhere in same file -> git rename detection (-M) -> symbol search -> fuzzy context similarity above threshold (needs confirmation) -> broken.
Body hash mismatch at the resolved spot = changed. Auto-fix rewrites hints for moved only, never for changed.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged c568071. AnchorResolver(root).Resolve/ResolveAll/Batch(); AnchorResolution(State Ok|Moved|Changed|Broken, Anchor, Resolved, FoundBy Hint|SameFile|Rename|Symbol|Fuzzy, Reason, Similarity); NeedsConfirmation == fuzzy. Fix(r) returns the new anchor only for confident Moved results. Fuzzy uses token Jaccard >= 0.7 and needs the old text from git (index, then up to 20 commits). Renames come from git diff -M (working tree) and the last commit; an untracked plain mv is Broken. Symbol search runs only for source extensions. Git.Run now decodes as UTF-8. Use one Batch per check run. Changed results carry the new hashes for a possible 'accept' action; Fix never applies them.
